incident.name: Change Healthcare Ransomware
incident.description: Largest healthcare data breach in US history. Disrupted prescription processing for weeks. $22M ransom paid.
incident.root_cause: No MFA on Citrix remote access, single point of failure in healthcare infrastructure
incident.lessons: Healthcare critical infrastructure requires MFA everywhere and resilient architecture.

relatedIncidents.name: Stryker MDM Wiper Attack
relatedIncidents.description: Iran-linked Handala group compromised a single Microsoft Intune admin account and remotely wiped 200,000+ devices across 79 countries. No malware — used Stryker's own MDM platform. Manufacturing and shipping halted. FBI seized Handala's infrastructure on March 19.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Single admin account compromise, no multi-party approval for mass device actions
relatedIncidents.lessons: Mass device management actions must require multi-party authorization. MDM platforms are high-value targets requiring privileged access controls.

relatedIncidents.name: Cegedim Santé Healthcare Breach
relatedIncidents.vector: Unauthorized access to healthcare SaaS platform
relatedIncidents.description: 15.8M French patient records stolen from Cegedim's MonLogicielMedical platform used by 3,800 doctors. Included sensitive free-text notes with HIV status, psychiatric diagnoses, and sexual orientation. Breach occurred Oct 2025, disclosed March 2026 — 4 months later.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Delayed breach disclosure, insufficient access controls on healthcare SaaS
relatedIncidents.lessons: Healthcare SaaS platforms holding sensitive clinical notes require the highest security standards. Breach disclosure delays harm patients.
